about_the_game:
Fortune is an ordinary small town shrouded by giant trees that blanket the entire planet. A murder case has disrupted the peace. You will play the role of a senior detective, collecting evidence along the way to revealing the truth. How the case will develop and end depends on your different choices.

 

As the investigation progresses, you will discover that the underlying causes behind the case are far from simple. The collusion between commercial companies and politicians continues to create more "accidents" for ordinary people, in order to conceal their pursuit of power and desires.

 

Meanwhile, you may wonder why the planet where Fortune Town is shrouded in countless giant trees, Why do residents resemble humans in appearance but have developed two completely different cultures and technologies in the upper World and under World. These mysteries can also be pieced together into a complete answer through the information you inadvertently collect.

 

This is an RPG detective narrative game. In the game, you can discover and collect props, clues, and other items in levels, seek out key characters, or explore this novel small town. Every step you take allows you to choose different story paths, which will guide the case investigation toward independent plotlines and influence the ending. We have prepared multiple endings, and any main character you encounter in the game may become a key figure affecting the case.
